title: CodexRunPlan
description: The brain's decomposition of the project into an ordered task queue.

goal.description: One-sentence restatement of the project goal.

successCriteria.description: How the whole run is judged complete.

tasks.description: Ordered task queue. The first task is dispatched immediately.

prompt.description: Self-contained instructions for one executor agent. No orchestrator will expand this.

verification.description: Objective evidence the executor must produce.

constraints.description: Hard rules for this task. Use an empty array when there are none.

dependsOn.description: Task ids that must be accepted first. Use an empty array when there are none.

notes.description: Optional notes about sequencing or risk. Use null when there are none.
